invariants.rule: Todo Orchestrator remains the sole workflow database, transaction, revision, scheduling, capability, and recovery authority.
Only project-control is registered as the live Codex MCP after cutover.

Cellerator is outside PCU-V1 mutation authority; only read-only Project Control observation and genuinely independent-clone rehearsal are allowed, and detected mutation is a campaign failure without automatic repair.
Candidate installation and final cutover retain an automatic restoration path.
No Skills shim or Todo component implements a workflow operation by calling another MCP server.
PCU-V1 does not delete the compatibility package, standalone Project Control checkout, historical worktrees, stale sessions, or state files.

tasks.title: Repin and cut over the corrected Project Control read provider
tasks.objective: Consume the ordinary forward Project Control remediation commit, rebuild the candidate, atomically update the existing project-control service and sole Codex registration, and prove all registered Todo authorities including the Cellerator sentinel through observer-only reads.
tasks.notes: External precondition: PCU-PC-40 has produced a clean ordinary forward Project Control commit. Cellerator verification is exclusively through Project Control's existing observer tools; never invoke Todo, Git, shell, or filesystem commands against its real checkout.

tasks.title: Retry the corrected read-port candidate cutover
tasks.objective: Consume the validated Project Control capability-remediation release, repin the existing submodule, rebuild and atomically cut over the candidate, and prove the complete Cellerator sentinel solely through observer reads.
tasks.notes: External precondition: PCU-PC-42 has produced a clean ordinary forward Project Control capability-remediation release. Cellerator remains observer-only without exception.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import json,re; d=json.loads(Path('unification/pcu-v1/evidence/read-port-remediation/pcu-sk-41.json').read_text()); assert d['result']=='validated'; assert d['profiles']['observer_tool_count']==15 and d['profiles']['codex_tool_count']==20; assert d['registration_names']==['project-control']; assert d['service']['active'] and d['service']['ready']; c=d['cellerator']; assert c['head']=='12a495f3dc3e3376728b160121086408be5f30f5' and c['clean'] and c['working_tree_fingerprint']=='e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855' and c['revision']==3016 and c['project_uuid']=='0ccaac37-dbbf-448e-a5f8-def197a70aba' and c['observer_only'] and not c['direct_access']; h=c['historical_fingerprint']; assert h['value']=='c15eb156aec331173cbb553948cccca8c99830acd1deafa64e532672b3c0cda5' and h['class']!='todo_read_authority_fingerprint' and not h['directly_comparable']; a=c['observer_semantic_baseline']; fp=a['read_authority_fingerprint']; assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',fp) and fp==a['semantic_state_fingerprint']==a['semantic_workflow_fingerprint']==a['repeat_read_authority_fingerprint']; assert a['baseline_sha256']==a['repeat_baseline_sha256'] and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',a['baseline_sha256']); assert not a['revision_skew'] and a['component_skew']==[] and a['provider_status']=='available'; q=d['quiescence']; assert q['active_claims_after']==0 and q['active_agents_after']==0 and q['local_children_after']==0

charter.objective: Repin and atomically deploy the corrected read-provider composition, then close the remaining PCU-V1 sentinel proof.
boundaries: Only project-control remains registered after success.
acceptance_conditions: The Skills gitlink pins the corrected Project Control commit.
The observer and Codex profiles retain exact 15 and 20 tool sets.
The observer exposes the unchanged Cellerator revision, UUID, HEAD, and authority fingerprint.
The installed service is healthy and only project-control is registered.
No downstream checkout was accessed directly or mutated.
